summary: J.P. Morgan Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026 solely to declare routine monthly distributions per share for Classes I, D, E, and Y common stock, with net distributions ranging from $0.0344 to $0.0423 per share. The filing also notes the waiver of the stockholder servicing fee on Class D shares in perpetuity and that no Class T, S, or X shares are outstanding. This is a standard periodic operational update with no event structural change, such as an acquisition, strategic review, or restructuring. There are no deal mechanics, advisor names, or regulatory deadlines beyond ordinary cash/tax treatment. Nothing to watch; filing is purely administrative.
